component.name: Open Device Helper
component.summary: Device settings for the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 5 (TB323FU) on Linux

description.p: A front-end for the tb323fu-helperd service: charge limit and bypass charging, battery and charger details, the in-kernel idle refresh rate, GPU profile and limits, torch and LED ring, USB wake and developer mode, the emergency key, switching back to Android, diagnostics export and version information.
The helper updates itself from the project's releases, with automatic rollback. The way back to Android works on systems without busybox.

Kernel updates from the project's releases and from a file, with automatic rollback; performance profiles with CPU and GPU limits, CPU boost and thermal profiles; panel heat protection; charging schedule; LED ring colours and breathing; vibration strength; wake on charger plug. Renamed to Open Device Helper.
